test_title: PYST 6 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Change the following sentence into the Active form.**

Why was the window broken by the child?

options.text: Why did the child break the window?
The child broke the window why?
Why the child broke the window?
Why has the child broken the window?

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Why did the child break the window?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is written in the **Passive Voice**.
